subject: Nexus Labs — promo stacking & onboarding billing carveout
body:
From: Maya Patel <maya@nexuslabs.ai>
To: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Promo stacking question for Launchpad cohort

Hi Irene,

Quick question from Nexus — we were accepted into your Launchpad cohort and received the standard $12k onboarding credit. We're evaluating Dedicated for Q3 and would like to know whether the cohort promo can be applied as a one-time credit against a Dedicated onboarding invoice (rather than token credits) or if it must remain as host-tier promo credits.

We'd also appreciate clarity on whether Summit partner promos stack with cohort credits or if only one promo applies per account. Attached a short statement of needs and the SOW draft for context.

Thanks — Maya

[Attachment: Nexus_Statement_of_Needs.pdf (PDF, 240KB)]
[Attachment: Draft_SOW_v2.docx (DOCX, 120KB)]

--
Maya Patel
Head of Growth, Nexus Labs
maya@nexuslabs.ai | +1 415-555-0172

-----Original Message-----

From: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
To: maya@nexuslabs.ai
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 18:03:20 +0000
Subject: Re: Promo stacking question for Launchpad cohort

Hi Maya — great to hear you folks are moving toward Dedicated. Short answer: we can often accommodate a carveout, but it depends on accounting and the contract type (prepaid vs committed monthly). I am looping in Vanessa for commercial packaging and Ben for precedent on onboarding carveouts.

For transparency, please confirm whether the Dedicated purchase would be a 12-month committed capacity or a shorter prepaid pilot. That will determine how Finance wants the promo recorded (one-time onboarding credit vs token-based offset).

Irene

--
Irene Choi
Head of GTM Programs, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com

On Wed, Jun 2, 2027 at 19:15 +0000 vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com wrote:

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: Promo stacking question for Launchpad cohort

Thanks for the context — Vanessa here. Our standard approach has been:
- If customer signs a multi-month committed Dedicated contract, we can convert cohort promo into a one-time onboarding credit applied to the first invoice (accounting code: PROMO_ONB).
- For prepaid pilots (month-by-month), promos remain token credits on the hosted account and cannot be applied directly as an invoice credit.

We make an exception for strategic launches where the total promo would exceed $10k and Legal/Finance approve a carveout; in those cases we create a one-time credit memo tied to the Dedicated contract.

If Nexus is aiming for 12-month committed capacity we can pursue the carveout route. Vanessa

--
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com

On Wed, Jun 2, 2027 at 20:00 +0000 ben.carter@redwoodinference.com wrote:

Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 20:00:43 +0000
Subject: Re: Promo stacking question for Launchpad cohort

Looping in a short precedent: last quarter we approved a $15k cohort->dedicated onboarding conversion for AeroScale (DEAL-7410) after Finance confirmed treatment as a one-time contra-revenue credit. Two notes from that approval:
1) We capped the conversion to 50% of the promo pool if there were other active partner promos.
2) We required a clause in the SOW stating the credit would be applied only to the onboarding invoice and had no cash-equivalent value.

If Nexus wants to stack Summit partner credits as well, we'll need both partner program owners to sign off; historically we limited stacking to avoid double-counting promotional uplift.

Ben

--
Ben Carter
Director, Growth Programs
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

On Thu, Jun 3, 2027 at 08:22 +0000 laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com wrote:

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 03 Jun 2027 08:22:11 +0000
Subject: Re: Promo stacking question for Launchpad cohort

Finance notes: we can do a one-time contra revenue credit memo if the Dedicated contract is >= 9 months and the customer provides a signed SOW/contract before billing starts. Need the following to proceed:
- Signed SOW or PO referencing Redwood Deal ID (DEAL-7584)
- Clear mapping of promo amount and GL code (we'll use PROMO_ONB / contra revenue)
- Confirmation there are no overlapping reseller/partner credits that would create an accounting mismatch

Also important: tax treatment differs by jurisdiction — for US customers we'll treat as contra revenue; for EU we may need to consider VAT implications. Please confirm Nexus's billing address.

Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: Promo stacking question for Launchpad cohort

Hi Maya — quick update and next steps:
1) If Nexus purchases a 12-month committed Dedicated package we can convert the $12k cohort promo into a one-time onboarding invoice credit via a credit memo (subject to the items Laura listed).
2) We can accept stacking with Summit partner promo up to a 50% cap of the cohort promo, pending partner sign-off.
3) To move forward: please send a signed SOW or PO that references DEAL-7584 and confirm Nexus billing address (+ whether Summit credits are active on the same account).

If you want, Vanessa can draft the amendment language for the SOW and Ben can share the AeroScale clause as a template.

Best,
Irene
